climate_pressure: Drought and erratic rainfall affecting rural livelihoods.
documented_impact: WFP reports historical agricultural and household-income damage in 2024.
fcv_mediator: Unequal access to basic services, violence, displacement and limited coping/implementation capacity can compound livelihood stress.
possible_consequence: Further food/water insecurity, migration, displacement and land tensions are conditional risks, not attributed observed conflict effects.
alternative_explanations: Violence, inequality, limited services and economic opportunity independently influence migration and food insecurity.
Tenure disputes and institutional weaknesses are not caused solely by weather.
uncertainty: Coordinator synthesis combining a historical impact account and a qualitative CCDR warning. No local causal test, quantified probability or event attribution; mechanisms require project-area verification.
resilience_factors: CCDR-recommended tenure security, livelihood diversification and locally led resilient investment.
compact_statement: Climate-related livelihood loss may compound existing exclusion and institutional constraints, increasing displacement or land-tension risks; the evidence does not establish climate-caused violence.
